title: Attribute provenance envelope
description: Every value inside an entity's `attributes` JSONB column is wrapped in this envelope (entity-model.md §2). Never write a bare scalar. Corrected 2026-08-04 to include `evidence` — the model supplies value/confidence/evidence, code adds source/run_id/observed_at.

value.description: The inferred or provided value. null is explicitly a valid answer when evidence is absent — code must not invent a value to satisfy validation (phase1-llm-boundary.md §2).

evidence.description: The snippet or reasoning that produced `value`. Model-supplied for LLM sources. May be null for non-LLM sources with no natural text evidence (provider API responses, human entry).

run_id.description: The agent_runs.id that produced this value. null for non-LLM sources (e.g. provider data).
